patch_description: This redesign separates board mechanics, heuristic evaluation, spatial sampling, and expectimax control into compact modules. It replaces phase-based rank sampling with distinct antithetic spatial samples: randomly selected empty cells are paired with cells nearest to their 180-degree mirrored positions. This improves coverage of both board regions while avoiding repeated chance outcomes. The heuristic returns to the stronger connectivity/center/strip shaping structure without the weaker mixed-edge penalty, while using a compact fixed-size board representation for faster simulation.
